subject: Re: VectorAI - slice quarantine & capacity signoff
messages:
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@vectorai.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VectorAI final capacity ask ahead of contract

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We ran the end-to-end perf tests overnight and are ready to lock in sizing so we can get our infra onboarding calendar confirmed. Summary below: 

- Target model: open-giant-xl (32k tokens)
- Expected 95th percentile latency budget: 120ms
- Estimated steady QPS: 6 concurrent sessions (avg sequence 4k tokens)
- Peak batch bursts: up to 24 concurrent sessions for short windows (30–60 minutes)
- Desired go-live window: week of Nov 16, 2026

Attached is our consolidated requirements PDF. High level ask: we need a dedicated pool that can sustain the steady-state with headroom for peaks; we understand Redwood supports temporary quarantine of node slices for late-stage deals to guarantee availability during procurement. Please confirm if you can quarantine the suggested slice count below and the estimated lead time to signal a reservation in the provisioning system.

Suggested slice hold: 6x A100-equivalent nodes (48GB) + 2x fallback T4-equivalents for short-burst fallback.

Also loop me in if you need anything for procurement/legal to proceed.

Best,
Natalie
Director of Platform Engineering
VectorAI

Attachments: VectorAI_final_capacity_requirements.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@vectorai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VectorAI final capacity ask ahead of contract

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Good news: we can provision a dedicated slice that matches the footprint you requested, and we can place a temporary quarantine on the exact nodes to cover your go-live window. A couple of clarifying questions so we quarantine correctly:

1) Can you confirm whether your workload requires persistent KV-cache pinning between sessions, or if session-level warm starts are acceptable? If persistent pinning is required we should add extra headroom for memory usage.
2) Do you have a hard constraint on region (we saw earlier you prefer us-west-2)?

Karthik/Ben — looping you both to kick off internal availability verification and a quick ops-runbook for the quarantine. I attached our proposed slice plan (draft) so ops can map node IDs and thermal constraints. Once we confirm, I will mark a provisional hold and send a formal quote + HubSpot stage update (DEAL-8372).

Natalie — assuming answers align, can we target a 72-hour confirmation so we can ensure the quarantine slot is visible in our provisioning UI?

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: dedicated-slice-plan-v2.xlsx (Excel, stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VectorAI final capacity ask ahead of contract

Aisha / Karthik — quick availability check from infra:

- We have an available contiguous group of 8 A100-equivalent nodes in us-west-2 (node IDs: node-uw2-a081..a088). Thermal and power headroom verified; attached the thermal-map snapshot.
- We can quarantine a 6-node slice today and keep the quarantine active for up to 45 days under a provisional hold policy. After 45 days we'll require either a conversion to reserved capacity (commit) or an extension request from sales.
- Fallback T4-equivalents: we can place two pre-warmed T4 nodes (t4-uw2-b12, t4-uw2-b13) in the same availability zone for burst fallback.
- Estimated ops work to lock the quarantine (tagging, pre-warm cache, provisioning flag): ~3 hours with the on-call provisioning engineer. ETA: same day if we approve now; otherwise next-business-day.

Operational notes and constraints:
- If VectorAI requires persistent KV-cache pinning, we recommend adding +10% GPU headroom to avoid memory spill to NVMe during warm starts.
- Quarantine consumes the nodes in our capacity planner and will show as "soft-locked" in the console; it will reduce flexibility for other sales opportunities — flagging for leader review if this needs to go beyond 14 days without conversion.

I can start the quarantine once we have a written confirmation from VectorAI and sales signs off.

Grace
Infrastructure Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: thermal-map-aurora-nodes.pdf (PDF, stub)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@vectorai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VectorAI final capacity ask ahead of contract

Hi Natalie — quick confirmation: thanks for clarifying earlier in the thread. VectorAI indicated session-level warm starts (no persistent KV pinning) in the attached requirements, so we will proceed without the extra +10% headroom.

Per Grace: we have 8 contiguous A100-equivalent nodes available in us-west-2 and can place a 6-node quarantine slice immediately. Ben and I are marking a provisional hold against DEAL-8372 in HubSpot and will submit the provisioning job. Ops estimates ~3 hours of work to complete the quarantine and pre-warm the cache; we expect the nodes to show as soft-locked in your console once complete.

Next steps:
- I'll place the quarantine today and share the provisioning job ID and runbook link (Drive) when it's created.
- Legal/procurement: please send any required PO/legal redlines — we can coordinate with Redwood Legal if needed.
- Let's schedule a 30-minute handoff call for Wed 2026-10-14 to review cutover plan and rollback triggers.

Thanks — will update once provisioning is in progress.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
